channel.description: Latest articles from Remington Research Group – Bias and Credibility (remingtonresearchgroup.com)

item.title: Biden approval ratings drop in seven key congressional districts: GOP-aligned poll
item.description: President Biden’s approval rating is under water in seven key congressional districts Democrats are defending in 2022, according to a GOP-aligned polling group, a sign of possible trouble for the party as it looks to protect its narrow House majority next year.

item.title: Trump endorses challenger to Republican Cheney in Wyoming House race
item.description: Former President Donald Trump endorsed Wyoming attorney Harriet Hageman's bid on Thursday to unseat U.S. Representative Liz Cheney, who was the highest-profile Republican to seek Trump's removal from office on a charge he incited the U.S. Capitol riot.

item.title: Police officer-turned-lawyer Chris Mann becomes first Democrat to enter attorney general race
item.description: Chris Mann, an attorney and former police officer, became the first Democrat to announce a campaign for attorney general Tuesday in a race where liberals hope the controversial presence of Kris Kobach could give them an opportunity.

item.title: GOP Senate Candidate Won’t Back McConnell For Leader Amid Escalating War With Trump
item.description: A leading Republican Senate candidate in Missouri said Tuesday he would not vote for Senate Minority Leader Mitch McConnell if elected, which comes as former President Donald Trump is reportedly looking to field a challenger against McConnell.

item.title: 4Star Politics: The likelihood KC sees a pitch for a new downtown baseball stadium
item.description: The Kansas City Royals are committed to playing baseball at the Truman Sports Complex for the next decade. After that, who knows? FOX4’s John Holt and The Kansas City Star’s Dave Helling are joined by Kevin Collison of City Scene KC in this week’s episode of 4Star Politics to discuss the Royals possible move downtown.

item.title: Sarah Huckabee Sanders’ Lead Insurmountable
item.description: KANSAS CITY, MO - A recent poll conducted by Remington Research Group found that a majority (51%) of American voters oppose The Green New Deal. The poll surveyed 1,212 registered voters nationwide.

item.title: New poll shows Sarah Huckabee Sanders with 57-point lead in Arkansas GOP primary
item.description: LITTLE ROCK, Ark. — (Eds. note: The video attached is from a Sarah Huckabee Sanders campaign event in Sept. 2021.) A new poll has put Sarah Huckabee Sanders with a commanding lead in the Republican Primary for the Arkansas governor race in 2022. Read full story

item.title: Schmitt leads GOP field in Senate race in latest poll
item.description: Attorney General Eric Schmitt has taken the lead in the U.S. Senate race among the GOP contenders in a new Remington Research Group poll released Saturday.
